hero.name: Diego Amado
hero.statement: I build digital systems that turn complex problems into simple solutions.
hero.supporting: Web development, automation and artificial intelligence for solving real-world problems.
hero.photoAlt: Pixel-art illustration of a developer seen from behind at a dual-monitor desk with code on screen, at dusk, with a dog resting on the rug and mountains outside the window
hero.ogImageAlt: Diego Amado, systems engineer and software engineer, next to an illustration of his workspace

about.heading: More than writing code, I design systems.

paragraphs.p1: I'm a systems engineer with more than six years of experience building software in production.
paragraphs.p2: I work mainly on the backend with Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript: APIs, modular architecture and asynchronous systems built on message queues. I also work across infrastructure, with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines, and on the frontend with Angular and Vue when a project needs it.
paragraphs.p3: I've spent the last four years working remotely as my team's go-to person on technical matters, while still writing code myself. I care about software architecture and anything that makes a system simpler to understand and maintain. On my own I build AI agents and automations, and I use AI daily as part of how I develop.

contact.heading: Have a project in mind?
contact.supporting: Let's talk about how I can help.
